title: Assigning contractual rights
summary: Assignment transfers a contractual right from its holder to another person. The assignee seeks the transferred benefit, while the underlying agreement determines what the obligor must provide.
notes:
Hamer begins with a claimant who acquired the nephew’s right through intermediate assignments. Masterson later raises the significance of an alleged restriction on transfer of an option. These examples show why identifying the original parties is not enough: a later claimant may hold a right acquired from one of them.

Distinguish assignment of a right from delegation of a duty. Also ask about any restriction on transfer, the nature of the right, notice, and defenses under the governing law. The final assignment includes only introductory pages on this subject.

textbookImport.basis: Plain-language synthesis of the cited casebook passages; subject to the jurisdictional and source limits stated there.

topics.assignment: The right to receive performance can pass to a later holder.
